items.title: Optional banner blur
items.text: Turn on “Blur my banner behind my profile” in your profile editor. Your banner is stretched, blurred and faded into your card theme.

items.title: New checkboxes
items.text: Every checkbox in Aduna now has the same rounded look, in your theme’s colors.

items.title: Smoother update notes
items.text: Update notes are now prepared for every release, so What’s new stays complete and up to date.
